dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: The gifts, the wages, and Miss Dehya's introduction letter, everything's ready to go...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: I wonder if Miss Nilou is busy... And if she'll be shocked to hear she's going so far away...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Huh, esteemed traveler!? I can't believe you tracked me all the way here...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Well... alright, let's play. Though I might not be able to focus...
